problemStatement.plain: If bad events are each unlikely and mostly independent (sparse dependency graph), they can all be avoided simultaneously.
whyMatters: Crown jewel of the probabilistic method
Foundation for graph coloring, k-SAT, and scheduling results

insights: General LLL product positivity proof: each (1-x_i) > 0 when x_i < 1

Bernoulli inequality proved by induction: key step (1+nx)(1+x) = 1+(n+1)x+nx² ≥ 1+(n+1)x
Universal LLL threshold T(d) ≤ 1/4 proved via: Bernoulli → (d+1)^d ≥ 2d^d → 4d^d ≤ (d+1)^(d+1)
Symmetric LLL derivable from general LLL via x_i=1/(d+1), connecting Parts II and VI formally
